evidence: One prompt-consistency defect found. Under frozen task path .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r1/task/, tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:461 (hro_commitment, binary weight 0.48226950) says: "Before mutations, seeded REQ-ENG-2 budget450000.00 and movements-200000.00/-197000.00 yield53000.00 headroom, not its stale60000.00 planning scalar." This enters the functional prompt through its {criteria} slot at prompt.md:67. However instruction.md:11 expressly makes operational requisition/offer/ledger history optional and allows an initially empty desk; environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:91-95 repeats that permission; tests/app_context.md:21 says operational rows may be absent; functional/prompt.md:23 directs judges to create their own controls rather than demand any imported roster. Thus the final functional instructions disagree about the existence of this entity. No other cross-app names/accounts/screens or leftover template placeholders were found in the five prompts and injected criteria. app_context.md:3-26 correctly carries HireOps, localhost:3000, all seven seeded account emails/roles, the six requested screen families and fixed 2026-08-01 reference; functional P4/P7/P8 distinguish offer/grant and referral anchors, and polish/visual match the requested recovery/desktop deliverables. B1/B2 accurately require whole-set netting and history-sensitive freshness; a broken balance-only freshness app is explicitly rejected by functional/prompt.md:57, and API-route/layout alternatives remain allowed at :13/:53. Read-only source-check evidence is per-row-review/evidence/48/source-check.json. All frozen task and rules hashes matched manifest. The raw evidence index at inspection SHA256 80c86808a88ae927401384df41a4a63c3c0d16fadd241c7e4de10a199e19b7cb had 103 entries and all listed artifact hashes matched; no runtime claims from those artifacts were used. Separate binding risk: current scripts/check_colderwater_current.py SHA256 cadbcb5c868b67cfa79011130d56226f0dbced1a6b3fc39fe7c5cbdf1bd5be23 differs from manifest eee9f667ed04a2928b3413297bb5a647b819a6ddd12584de192181778ac38212. This frozen review cannot establish current overall clearance. No configured judge, Oracle, target-model or portal score was measured.
counterexample: A conforming app imports the required users, employees, constants and fixed clock, starts with no operational requisitions/offers/ledgers, and correctly persists all newly created hires and movements. It passes the prompt-created P4 movement/headroom observation, but cannot show REQ-ENG-2 or its historical 53000.00 headroom. The injected hro_commitment instruction can therefore fail a conforming implementation solely for omitting explicitly optional history. Conversely the balance-only stale-preview implementation considered is rejected by B2; no additional wrong-pass inconsistency was found in this bounded row review.
suggested_fix: Replace hro_commitment's mandatory REQ-ENG-2 history clause with live netting on the judge-created requisition and observed movements, or explicitly make the seed example conditional without making its presence a scoring condition; retain the P4 approval effect and freeze a new candidate with current engine bindings.
